# SoraTabs

Switches between panels from a typed array of tabs.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | navigation |
| Import | `import { SoraTabs } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraTabs from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraTabs'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/navigation/SoraTabs.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/navigation/SoraTabs.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends SoraTabItem` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` **(required)** | `readonly TItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list. |
| `orientation` | `SoraOrientation` | `'horizontal'` | Layout direction. |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `'automatic'` | `automatic` selects a tab as soon as it receives focus; `manual` waits for Enter or Space (use it when showing a panel is expensive). |
| `variant` | `'underline' \| 'pill'` | `'underline'` | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `fitted` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch the tabs across the available width. |

## Models

| v-model | Type |  | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v-model` | `T['value']` | required | `value` of the selected tab. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `props: { item: T }` | Content of the selected tab's panel. |
| `tab` | `props: { item: T; selected: boolean }` | Content of one tab (the label by default). |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Keyboard

- Arrow keys move between tabs along the orientation (mirrored in right-to-left text); Home/End jump.
- `activation="automatic"` selects on focus; `"manual"` selects on Enter or Space.
- Tab moves from the selected tab into the panel.

## Accessibility

- APG tabs: `role="tablist"`/`tab`/`tabpanel`, `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`, roving `tabindex`.
- Disabled tabs are skipped.
- The selected tab is marked by a bar or fill, not by colour alone.

## Styling

- `.sora-tabs`, `.sora-tabs__list`, `.sora-tabs__tab`, `.sora-tabs__panel`
- `data-orientation`, `data-variant`, `data-size`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
  <SoraTabs v-model="tab" :items="tabs" :label="t('demo.tabs.label')">
    <template #content="{ item }">
      <p class="text-sora-sm text-sora-muted">{{ item.body }}</p>
    </template>
  </SoraTabs>
  <SoraTabs
    v-model="sideTab"
    :items="tabs"
    :label="t('demo.tabs.label')"
    orientation="vertical"
    variant="pill"
    activation="manual"
  >
    <template #content="{ item }">
      <p class="text-sora-sm text-sora-muted">{{ item.body }}</p>
    </template>
  </SoraTabs>
</div>
```
